# BigBrainDevBros Copilot And Agent Instructions

1. Follow `template.md` and `check.md` in `BigBrainDevBros/.github` as the canonical source of truth.
2. Keep all tracked file and directory names lowercase (except `CNAME` and `TornTools`).
3. Format all commit messages as `type: word1 word2 word3` matching `^[a-z]+: [a-z0-9]+ [a-z0-9]+ [a-z0-9]+$`.
4. Never embed emojis or direct binary download links (`.dmg`, `.zip`, `.exe`, `.tar.gz`) in Markdown files.
5. Support English and Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`): keep code identifiers, commits, tags, labels, and `[PREFIX]` tags in English; update `readme.zh-cn.md` alongside `readme.md` when present.
6. Never force-push `main`, overwrite teammate work, or publish tags/releases without explicit maintainer approval.
